annotations.title: Two traditions, side by side, charitably

description: Look up two Christian denominations in the Christian Knowledge API (live) and return them side by side: each one's id, page, parent tradition, up to 12 branches and sameAs links, plus a shared parent when both have the same one. It returns structure and links, not a doctrinal comparison table, and never ranks traditions. Use for "Baptists vs Methodists" or "are Pentecostals Protestant". For a single tradition use heritage_lookup; for what a doctrine means use belief. a and b are names or slugs, each resolved independently (slug first, then by meaning), and order does not matter. If one name is not held, that side is null; if neither is held, an error. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

a.description: First denomination by name or slug: "Methodism", "Baptists", "Catholic Church".

b.description: Second denomination, same format: "Eastern Orthodox Church".

name: denomination_compare

a.description: First tradition: lb: id, name, page, parent, branch ids, sameAs links; null when not held.

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

b.description: Second tradition, same shape; null when not held.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

door.description: The house's overview of Christian traditions.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

posture.description: The house's stance on describing traditions, in its words.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

shared_root.description: The lb: id of a parent both share, or null.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.
